newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bomber crashes, killing pilot - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech bomber crashes, killing pilot - CTK.

text.p: A Czech fighter-bomber aircraft on a training flight crashed on Friday, killing the pilot, the CTK agency reported.

It quoted a defence ministry spokesman as saying the Soviet-made Su-22 M4 plane crashed near the town of Tasovice na Blanensku, about 200 km (125 miles) southeast of Prague. The cause of the crash was not reported.
CTK quoted a police source as saying the pilot was killed instantly. It was not immediately known if anyone else was on board.
